shortDesc.message: Hide private messages inside innocent public phrases. Encrypt and decode text right in Facebook, VK, LinkedIn and Telegram chats.

storeDesc.message:
Secret Message turns a private message into an ordinary-looking public phrase that fits the conversation: a friendly comment under a post or a reply in a chat. Only people who know your workspace and password can read the private message behind it. No registration, no account.

Convert in place:
▸ Type your private message right in a comment, reply or chat box on Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Telegram Web or any other site
▸ Press Ctrl+Shift+E or right-click → Convert into secret message
▸ The text is replaced with a natural public phrase that answers the post or comment; post it as usual
▸ A name or mention at the start of a reply stays in front of the phrase

Read secret messages:
▸ Turn on auto decoding with Ctrl+Shift+L or the right-click menu (Facebook, Messenger, VK, LinkedIn, Telegram Web)
▸ Hold the mouse pointer over a message: the private text appears right after it

The widget:
▸ Click the icon or press Ctrl+Shift+Y for a compact widget on the page: write and encode messages, choose the topic, style and language of the phrase, edit the conversation history
▸ Built-in help, privacy policy and contact buttons; a short video shows how it works after installing
▸ On a Mac, use Control instead of Ctrl

Security:
🔒 AES-GCM encryption performed locally in your browser, with a key derived from your password
🔒 Workspace + password protection, optional owner signature
🔒 Settings are stored encrypted for each site and saved automatically when you change them; the message history is never saved
🔒 No analytics, no ads, no tracking

Free limits: 20 encoded messages and 1000 decoding lookups per day for each internet connection. Need more? Write to sfile4share@gmail.com.

autoDecodingCommandDesc.message: Turn auto decoding of secret messages on or off

convertCommandDesc.message: Convert the text in the focused text box into a secret message
